model.description: 8B-class public transformer dimensions; not a specific released model

device.description: illustrative constants, not a measured or named device

definitions.ttft: first committed token − arrival, per request
definitions.tpot: (last commit − first commit) ÷ (output tokens − 1), per sample with ≥ 2 output tokens, rounded down
definitions.throughput: committed output tokens (finished requests) per second, first arrival to last finish
definitions.kv_utilization_mean: device blocks in use at each step's end, weighted by step duration, ÷ capacity
definitions.prefix_hit_rate: prefix-cache blocks adopted ÷ full prompt blocks eligible, at admission
definitions.swap_bytes_all_devices: swapped-out plus swapped-in blocks × block bytes per device × P

config.invariants: every run checks the scheduler and token-stream invariants after every step, and the KV-cache invariants after every kv_check_interval_steps-th step, after every failure and after the last step

failures.guarantees: G1 no leaked blocks, G2 no duplicated tokens, G3 nothing lost under retry and G4 exactly one ending are checked inside every run (a violation stops the experiment with an error); G5 determinism: each failure run is run twice and its traces compared (rerun_identical)
